SELECT MAX(marketstatsmark) AS max_market_stats_id
FROM marketstats;

SELECT 
    t1.recordvault AS order_reference,
    t1.dealedge AS trade_side,
    t1.dealcount AS order_quantity,
    t2.quote_depth_snapshot AS market_depth_details
FROM 
    orders AS t1
JOIN 
    marketdata AS t2 ON t1.mktnote = t2.quote_depth_snapshot->'metadata'->>'mktcombo'
JOIN 
    marketstats AS t3 ON t2.marketdatanode = t3.mdlink
WHERE 
    t3.marketstatsmark = 1000;
